units: <cite ref="Niddah 66b:27">Nidd. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דבעיתא</he> because she is excited (afraid of falling down).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:5">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 5</cite> (Ms. <he>בְּעֵיתַת</he> Pe.).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 77b:10">Keth. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא מְבַעֲתַת לי</he> lest thou frighten me.
<cite ref="Chullin 53a">Ḥull. 53ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>בַּעוּתֵי קא מְבַעֲתֵי אהדדי</he> they frighten each other.
<cite ref="Niddah 66a:25">Nidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>זיל בַּעֲתָהּ</he> go and frighten her (by a sudden noise).

senses.gloss: to be afraid; to be agitated, anxious, in haste (cmp. b. h. חָרַד).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 21:2">Targ. I Sam. XXI, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 22:4">Targ. Is. XXII, 4</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 7:15">Targ. II Kings VII, 15</cite> <he>באִתְבְּעָתוּתְהוֹן</he> Regia (ed. <he>באתבעותהון</he>); v. <cite ref="B01058"><he>בְּעַע</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B01037"><he>בְּעֵי</he> I</cite>. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ bot. <he>והוא מתבעת</he> and he is afraid (to touch the wine).—
<cite ref="Megillah 3a:14">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מאן דמִיבְּעִית</he> when one is suddenly seized with fright.
<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:2">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה מיבעית ליה בעותי</he> he ran anxiously to meet him; cmp. Targ. I Sam. l. c.; a. fr.
